name: cooltunnel
description: Share local sites instantly with a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel.
author: Cool Plugins LLP

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --configLoader runner" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:5173 dist-electron/electron/main.js dist-electron/electron/preload.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run icons && npm run typecheck && vite build --configLoader runner && npm run build:electron && node scripts/verify-build.mjs && node scripts/validate-brand.mjs && npm run validate:site
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis && node scripts/finalize-release.mjs
scripts.release:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --publish never && node scripts/finalize-release.mjs
